subject: Civil Engineering
title: Vibro Compaction and Stone Columns
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Vibro Compaction and Stone Columns.

hook.text: Vibrating probes can turn loose sand into dense sand in minutes — on the spot.

buildup.text: Vibro compaction shakes sand grains into tighter packing. Density jumps immediately.

discovery.text: For silty or clayey soils, stone columns replace the weak soil with compacted gravel.

twist.text: Stone columns also act as drains — water escapes through the gravel faster.

climax.text: Both methods are used to prepare land reclamation sites for heavy construction.

punchline.text: Vibrate the ground or replace it — either way, it gets stronger.

quiz.question: What additional benefit do stone columns provide beyond load support?
options: They insulate the soil from temperature changes
They act as drainage paths, allowing water to escape faster
They prevent earthquakes from reaching the surface
